scope: Selected operator controller adoption and one new full validation of current code. Previous d740 full result is historical and not reused.

adoption.before: Only helper/tests had adopted the safe sequence. The old selected external entry still contained direct JSON reads and class-only exception reporting.
adoption.after: Selected legacy entry run_fixed_connection_once.py now imports talkabout.trial_controller.main. Versioned tools/run_trial_diagnostic.py imports the same main, which executes run_diagnostic. The controller, not its caller, installs TrialRecord.observe, closes the runtime, finalizes the attempt, publishes the independent safe report and re-reads it.

entry_check.actual_mode: not exposed by CLI; synthetic flag required

adoption.scope_boundary: CLI requires --synthetic and has no actual provider mode. The shared lifecycle can accept a supplied runtime instance under a separately authorized operator workflow; no implicit authentication, token issuance, API room provisioning or budget expansion is implemented. Original actual trial records and stop latches remain untouched.
adoption.original_controller: Archived byte-for-byte before replacing the selected entry. No historical source or record is reclassified.

controller_behavior: A new exclusive result directory prevents reopening/resetting an earlier reservation. Every JSON read/update after initialization uses existing TrialRecord locks.
Controller installs the fixed-stage observer itself; callers no longer need to assemble the helper sequence. It keeps the first observer exception and its stage even if cleanup observes later events.
Runtime shutdown occurs before completed reporting. Final status requires a completed summarized outcome and a successfully re-read independent report. Failure is never converted to success.

On failure, the controller emits safe relative-source/operation/numeric error/stage/native-state metadata before independent persistence. Failure of the second sink emits a secondary safe error and leaves the primary available.
Post-start persistence failures keep started=1; absent evidence remains unknown. Explicit pre-launch live not_requested can establish zero. No missing counter is defaulted to zero.
All current CLI native children are exact Python-only synthetic JSONL processes, with auth/preflight stubbed and a minimal environment. Synthetic evidence is labeled in saved reports and CLI output.
